snippet.title: Hirogami | Launch Trailer | Out Now on PC & PS5!
snippet.description:
Origami-inspired 3D platformer Hirogami is OUT NOW on PC (Steam, Epic Games Store) and PlayStation 5! 🌸

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3135840/Hirogami/
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/hirogami-c13599
PlayStation Store: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/HP3620-PPSA29173_00-0647071670056701/

Explore a fragile origami world as Hiro, a brave warrior who has mastered the art of folding. Using your powers of origami animal transformation, you'll crash, leap, swing, and soar through this papercraft paradise as you solve puzzles, best foes, and save your homeland from ruthless digital invaders!

#videogames #outnow #steamgame #playstation5 #platformer
